listing.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Racing-8-DX-Recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Mario Kart 8 Deluxe project documenting strict ahead-of-time translation with SUYU_NO_JIT=ON and native Vulkan. Its emulator ancestry alone does not prove runtime CPU JIT; strict coverage has not been exercised. The project claims 60 FPS races and four-player play on AMD. DLSS compiles but has not been tested on NVIDIA; game rates above 60 FPS are planned. On November 18, 2026, the upstream BETA-0.2.5 prerelease offered a Linux x86-64 AppImage, and v0.2.4 offered a Windows ZIP and Linux AppImage. Use the upstream release instructions for the exact build; Portcove has not exercised these packages. Android remains in development. Use your own base game and 3.0.4 update, with optional owned DLC. The upstream BETA-0.2.5 guide offers a decrypted-dump route without keys or firmware and lists the requirements for other input routes. Generated rtld/main/subsdk modules remain private; exact region/build hashes are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
